## Activity

During July 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 188 captures. Activity was monitored through the month, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. No operational issue was identified in the supplied activity information beyond the routine leave noted above.

## Image quality

Of the 188 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.1. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be considered in routine quality review, with attention given to any recurring issues that may affect image acquisition or interpretation.

## Grading

Grading identified 55 referable cases. The median lag from capture to grading was 9. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during July 2024. Overall, the available information records the clinic’s activity, the proportion of images that could not be graded, and the referable findings returned during the reporting period.
